verdict: The product moments are believable and every control I touched does something honest: the Try box handles junk, already-sharp, over-280 and put-back cases, the signup sheet traps and returns focus, validates email and says plainly that it is a preview, and the page holds its budgets (2-line headings, 9.98 screens at 390, 10.38 at 360, CLS ~0, no horizontal scroll, no console errors). It sits a hair under 9.5 because the Voice card opens mid-story in a state the visitor never caused, and the long-line result explains a split the card does not show.
to_95: Voice card: start it in the untouched state (ngl struck, counter at 0 of 2, helper 'Put it back twice and it stays'), so the first thing a visitor reads is the rule, not 'Put back once already', an action they never took.

Over-280 result in the Try box: when the second beat falls into post 2, either show a dimmed 'Post 2' stub under the card or change the status and Why it hits to the thread explanation only, so 'Split it into two beats' is not claimed over a card that shows a single sentence.
Raise the two small in-sheet targets on phones (text link 'Sign in' 42x20, close 36x36) to a 44px hit area, as already done for the 'Try it' pills.

issues.problem: The card loads reading 'Put back once already. Once more and it stays.' with one of two dots filled. The visitor has not put anything back, so the first read of the section's only interactive control is a status about an action they did not take; the learning rule has to be inferred. After two taps the copy becomes 'Unlearned. Put it back twice and it stays.', which is the clear version, shown last.
issues.fix: Initial state: 0 of 2 dots, helper 'Put it back twice and it stays.' First tap: 'Put back once. Once more and it stays.' Second tap: 'Learned: "ngl" stays from now on.' Keep the reset as is.

issues.where: #out-st / #out-why when the draft is over 280 (tested with a 290-char trader line)
issues.problem: Status says 'Cut 2 bits of fluff · Split it into two beats' and Why it hits says 'Two short beats with a full stop between them. The pause makes the second one land.', but the post card shows post 1 only, a single sentence. The second beat is in post 2, which is not drawn, so the explanation describes something the visitor cannot see. The draft's last line is also faded with no label saying why.
issues.fix: When rest is non-empty, drop the beats claim from the status ('Cut 2 bits of fluff · Opens a 2-post thread') and lead Why it hits with the thread note; add a one-line dimmed 'Post 2: which is how I blew up my first account…' stub under the card. Label the faded tail 'goes to post 2'.

issues.problem: Both are under 44px on a phone and have no extended hit area, unlike the 'Try it' pills, which extend 10px above and 15px below.
issues.fix: Add the same ::after hit-area extension: 12px vertical on the Sign in / Create account link, 4px all round on close.

issues.where: Pasting 'So excited to announce that we're thrilled to launch v2.0 of our API at https://example.com/launch today!!!'
issues.problem: Result ends 'today!!' : one exclamation mark is removed and two are left, with no mark on the draft for it. It reads as a glitch, and it is an unmarked change in a product whose promise is that every cut is marked.
issues.fix: Either leave punctuation runs untouched, or reduce to a single '!' and show it as a struck mark that can be put back.

issues.problem: Four mutually exclusive views are exposed as independent aria-pressed toggle buttons, each a separate tab stop, with no arrow-key movement. A screen-reader user hears four toggles, not one choice of four; the pricing Yearly/Monthly pair has the same pattern.
issues.fix: Use role=tablist/tab with aria-selected and roving tabindex (Left/Right moves and selects), panel as role=tabpanel; or a radiogroup for the billing pair.

issues.problem: About 130px of empty photo sits between the two-line heading and the first timeline card, so the heading and the 11:04 PM card do not read as one sequence at first glance; the phone on the right starts higher than the timeline on the left.
issues.fix: Pull the timeline up to 40-48px under the heading (or top-align it with the phone's status bar) and let the spare photo show below the last card.
